●    xenonet   Xeno green on void black
     phosphor  Amber phosphor on black glass, like an old monochrome terminal
     ochre     Dunes under a bruised sky: ochre, rust and the blue of a desert night
     gridline  Light trails on an endless grid, in electric cyan and orange on black
     helios    The sun's surface up close: white-gold light, plasma orange and magnetic magenta
               loops
     rime      Frost on black glass: glacier blue and white under a faint aurora
     trench    The deep sea at night: black water, and the cold light of things that glow on their
               own
     eclipse   Totality: black and white with one ring of light, and color only where something
               needs you, in hues color-blind eyes tell apart

Yours go in ~/.xenonet-state/themes; xenonet theme copy starts one.
